_comment: Expectations for the EpubSequenceMatcher harness. The EpubIndex and CoarseSegment fixtures are hand-built in tests/epub_sequence_matcher_harness.cpp (no real .epub is needed); this manifest drives, per named case, the outcome the matcher must produce. 'matched' is the accept/reject verdict; 'minAnchors' is the floor on the monotonic anchor chain; 'expectKinds' lists region kinds that MUST appear.
